concerns.text: FR-007 requires three independent, non‑circular motion‑reliance checks (linear probe, motion‑feature ablation, and motion‑only test). Task T008 only implements the motion‑only test; there are no tasks for a linear probe on learned features or for a motion‑feature ablation, violating FR‑007 and SC‑006.

FR-009 mandates a sweep of the optical‑flow divergence threshold ({0.10, 0.15, 0.20}) with retention‑rate reporting. Task T005 performs a single‑threshold check (≤ 0.15) and does not include any sweep or reporting step, thus weakening the specification.

SC‑006 expects three independent motion‑reliance evidences. Only the motion‑only test (T008) is present; the other two evidences (linear probe and motion‑feature ablation) are missing, so the success criterion cannot be fully measured.

Constitution VI (Counterfactual Integrity) requires that each generated pair record the original bounding‑box (`bbox`) and the identifier of the patch used (`patch_source_id`). Task T003’s description does not mention writing these fields to `metadata.csv`; it only says to append a row with all fields except `optical_flow_divergence` and `status`, but the required fields are not explicitly listed, risking a violation of the Counterfactual Integrity principle.

FR-001 states that a counterfactual pair must be *included* in the dataset only after the optical‑flow divergence check (≤ 0.15) passes. T003 creates metadata rows before any divergence check and only later (in T005) updates status or rejects rows. This sequence weakens the functional requirement by allowing rejected pairs to be temporarily present in the dataset.
